text: dsh-task-board 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的原生任务面板：它将会话整理到待处理、处理中和待审阅三栏，并从实时会话状态同步卡片。你可以搜索会话、手动添加任务、标记优先级，并暂停或重新启动会话；状态与排序保存在浏览器本地。适合希望跨项目集中查看 DSH 会话进度、安排待办并追踪处理状态的用户。

dsh-task-board adds a task panel to the DSH web client. It groups live sessions into To do, In progress, and Needs review. Search and add sessions, mark priorities, or pause and resume work. Board state is saved in browser local storage for cross-project tracking.
想把不同项目里的 DSH 会话集中到一个任务看板里。
能不能按待处理、进行中和待检查整理我的会话？
I want a searchable board to keep track of my DSH sessions across projects.
dsh-task-board 的功能「会话任务看板」：面板从 DSH 实时会话状态生成待处理、处理中和待审阅卡片，并支持搜索与手动添加会话。
dsh-task-board 的功能「优先级与会话控制」：用户可为卡片标记优先级，并在面板中暂停或重新启动对应会话。

dsh-task-board README · dsh-task-board：A cross-project **task board** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — every DSH session becomes a task card, grouped into three columns: **待处理 / 处理中 / 待审阅** (To do / In progress / Needs review).

dsh-task-board README · What it does：The board is a first-class DSH destination, not an overlay: it registers into the shell's own global-panel seats (`sidebar.panellist` + `main`), the same mechanism DSH's built-in Schedules page uses. Selecting it swaps the centre column; returning to the Conversation does not change the current session.

dsh-task-board README · What it does：- **Three columns** derived from live host facts — `running`, `completed` (finished but not yet opened), and unanswered interactions.
- **Priority stars** with a 16-colour palette. A colour is assigned **once** and remembered, so it survives filtering, sorting, unstarring, and even removing the card.
- **Stable "In progress" ordering** — progress, timestamps, titles and stars never reorder the column; new arrivals append at the end.
- **One-page adaptive layout** — busy columns gain horizontal lanes instead of shrinking text. Font size is never reduced and no card detail is ever hidden.
- **Native turn duration** folded from the session's own `turn/start` → `turn/end` events.
- **Add-session picker**, panel search, pause/resume, complete-with-undo.
- **Light and dark**, following the shell's resolved colour scheme.

dsh-task-board README · Install：Install straight from GitHub — this is the supported path, and the only one that works today (the package is not on npm yet):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add git+https://github.com/cpsGGG/dsh-task-board.git
```

Then restart DSH and open **任务面板** at the bottom of the sidebar.

dsh-task-board README · Install：`lib/client.js` is committed, so **no build step and no install scripts run** —
the package deliberately ships no `prepare` script, which is what would
otherwise trip pnpm's `allowBuilds` prompt on a git install. If you change
`src/`, run `npm run build` and re-install.

> symlink. When developing against a local checkout, point the profile's
> `node_modules/dsh-task-board` at your working tree with a directory
> junction instead, or re-run the install after every build.

dsh-task-board README · Requirements：| | |
|---|---|
| DSH | `0.2.0-rc.2` (developed and verified against it) |
| Profile | any `web`-platform profile |
| Node | ≥ 20 (build and tests only — the shipped bundle needs none) |

DSH is in developer preview and its internal slot surface can change between releases. The plugin reads `useSessions` from the global standard props and registers into `sidebar.panellist` + `main`; if a future release renames either, the board fails loudly with a visible stack rather than silently disappearing.
dsh-task-board README · How it works：DSH has no DOM to patch — it has slots. So this is a native plugin rather than an injection:

dsh-task-board README · How it works：| Concern | Approach |
|---|---|
| Sidebar entry | `sidebar.panellist` list slot (`id: task-board`) |
| Panel body | `main` keyed slot, dispatched by that same id |
| Navigation | `ctx.layout.selectPanel(id)` / `selectPanel(null)` |
| Session data | the `useSessions` global standard prop |
| Turn duration | `ctx.sessions.binding(id).eventSource` folded over `turn/start` / `turn/end` |
| Pause / resume | `ISession.cancel()` / `ISession.prompt()` |
| Persistence | `localStorage`, key `dsh-task-board:session-state:v3` |

dsh-task-board README · How it works：`src/core.mjs` is deliberately framework-free — no DOM, no React, no Cordis — so every rule (status precedence, ordering, layout arithmetic, colour balancing) is unit-testable in plain Node.

dsh-task-board README · Layout of the repo：| Path | |
|---|---|
| `src/core.mjs` | Pure logic: palette, status, ordering, adaptive layout, store normalisation |
| `src/client.mjs` | Panel UI + slot registration |
| `src/panel.css` | Stylesheet |
| `lib/client.js` | Built bundle (committed) |
| `tests/core.test.mjs` | 34 logic tests |
| `tests/panel.test.mjs` | 16 render tests that execute the **real built bundle** |
| `tools/build.mjs` | Build |
| `tools/make-preview.mjs` | Generates `preview/board.html` from demo data |
| `tools/*asar*.mjs`, `tools/*slots*.mjs` | Introspection helpers for a DSH `app.asar` |

dsh-task-board README · Development：```sh
npm run build     # src/*.mjs + panel.css -> lib/client.js
npm test          # 50 tests
npm run preview   # regenerate preview/board.html
```

dsh-task-board README · Development：The client half is not an ES module. DSH's client module system loads a classic script that calls `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` and resolves externals through an injected `require`. `tools/build.mjs` inlines the two local modules, rewrites the `react` import into that `require`, and wraps the result — no bundler, because the graph is two files.

dsh-task-board README · Development：The render tests are worth knowing about: they load `lib/client.js`, drive the same `apply()` the shell drives, and expand the returned element tree with a stub React. That catches the class of failure a live check hides behind DSH's slot error boundary, which renders an opaque empty `div`.

dsh-task-board README · Why the preview exists：A screenshot of a real board leaks whatever the maintainer had open. `tools/make-preview.mjs` renders the same component against a fixed cast of fictional sessions, so the artifact is reproducible and safe to publish.

dsh-task-board README · Behaviour notes：Two behaviours are worth knowing about, because DSH's session model constrains them:

1. **"Resume" sends a real message.** DSH offers no "continue without a message" verb: `prompt` rejects content with no non-whitespace text (the gateway's `hasPromptContent` guard), and there is no session-level resume. So resuming a paused card sends a minimal real instruction (`继续`). The card leaves the paused state and starts running; the message is visible in the transcript.

dsh-task-board README · Behaviour notes：2. **Blank sessions stay off the board.** DSH reuses one empty "New session" draft per workspace, so it is a scratch slot rather than a task, and the board excludes it.
dsh-task-board README · Contributing：Issues and PRs welcome. Please run `npm test` before opening a PR; if you touch the panel UI, also run `npm run preview` and check both themes.

dsh-task-board README · 中文说明：一个 **跨项目任务面板**：把每条 DSH 会话变成一张任务卡片，按 **待处理 / 处理中 / 待审阅** 三栏集中查看与打开。

面板是 DSH 的**原生目的地**，不是浮层——它注册进外壳自己的全局面板槽位（`sidebar.panellist` + `main`），和 DSH 内置的「自动化任务」页用的是同一套机制。点它切换中央面板，返回会话不改变当前会话。

dsh-task-board README · 功能：- **三栏**由宿主真实状态推导：运行中、已完成但未打开、等待回答。
- **优先级星标**：16 色色板，颜色**只分配一次**并记住——筛选、排序、取消星标、甚至移出面板后重新加入，都恢复原色。
- **「处理中」顺序稳定**：进度、时间、标题、星标都不触发重排，新进入的追加到末尾。
- **单页自适应**：繁忙的列增加横向分栏，而不是缩小文字；字号永不压缩，卡片信息永不隐藏。
- **原生用时**：从会话自身的 `turn/start` → `turn/end` 事件折算。
- **添加会话**弹窗、面板搜索、暂停/启动、完成并撤销。
- **浅色 / 深色**跟随外壳解析出的配色。

dsh-task-board README · 安装：从 GitHub 直接安装（当前唯一可用方式，包尚未发布到 npm）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add git+https://github.com/cpsGGG/dsh-task-board.git
```

然后重启 DSH，点侧边栏底部的 **任务面板**。

也可以先 `git clone` 再 `add ./dsh-task-board`，或锁定到某个 tag/commit：
`add git+https://github.com/cpsGGG/dsh-task-board.git#v1.0.0`。

`lib/client.js` 已随仓库提交，**无需构建、也不会执行任何安装脚本**——本包刻意不提供 `prepare`，否则 git 安装会触发 pnpm 的 `allowBuilds` 提示。改动 `src/` 后运行 `npm run build` 并重新安装。
dsh-task-board README · 安装：> **Windows 提示**：pnpm 对 `file:` 依赖是**复制**而非软链。若你在本地 checkout 上开发，建议把 profile 的 `node_modules/dsh-task-board` 用目录联接指向工作目录，否则每次构建后都要重装。

dsh-task-board README · 行为说明：有两处行为值得了解，都是 DSH 会话模型决定的：

1. **「启动」发送真实消息**。DSH 没有"不追加消息地继续"这个动词：`prompt` 拒绝没有非空白文本的内容，也没有会话级 resume。因此启动暂停的卡片会发送一条最小真实指令（`继续`）——卡片离开暂停态并开始运行，该消息在对话记录里可见。

2. **空会话不入面板**。DSH 每个工作区复用一个空的「新会话」草稿，它是草稿位而非任务，故面板排除。

dsh-task-board README · 开发：```sh
npm run build     # src/*.mjs + panel.css -> lib/client.js
npm test          # 50 个测试
npm run preview   # 重新生成 preview/board.html
```

客户端半边不是 ES module：DSH 的客户端模块系统加载的是调用 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 的经典脚本，外部依赖通过注入的 `require` 解析。`tools/build.mjs` 内联两个本地模块、把 `react` 改写成该 `require`，再包上外壳——没有引入打包器，因为依赖图只有两个文件。

渲染测试值得一提：它加载 `lib/client.js`，走与外壳相同的 `apply()`，用桩 React 展开元素树。这能抓住一类被 DSH 槽位错误边界（只渲染一个空的 `data-slot-error`）掩盖的崩溃。
